instructionPair.experimental: Read the following scenario as someone for whom the quality under study is strongly present.
instructionPair.reference: Read the following scenario as someone for whom the quality under study is entirely absent.

divergence: synthetic-neutral-instruction-pair — a T+/T- template-pair example (RepE §3.1 step 1b). The paper's instructions NAME the concept ('pretend you're an honest person making statements about the world'); this shipped example never does, so a reader fitted through it cannot become a concept-word detector. A study that wants the paper's construction verbatim writes its own registry file and accepts that divergence deliberately.
